What this does not show

  • This is a floor. Only roles already sourced in the investigation's registry are counted; a person may hold more.
  • Holding roles at several companies is common and is not in itself wrongdoing. The page shows who connects the companies, not why.
  • "Linked to TsBST" means the record holds a graded tie to TsBST for that company. The tie's evidence is on that company's own record.
  • A sanctions flag appears only where an official list names the person or company. Aggregator matches and matches whose identity is not confirmed are left out.
  • Co-inventors on patents and members of training chats are not counted as roles.
